source: 'Caros Ledge UI System.dc.html' id="p13" (Platform admin), the 4-up tile grid directly under the masthead — each tile: `background:#fff;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.12);border-radius:10px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(26,26,26,.04),0 4px 14px rgba(26,26,26,.06);padding:0 14px 12px 14px`; label `font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:800`; numeral `font-family:'Anton';font-size:16px`; note `font-size:11.5px;color:#5A6B67;margin-top:4px;line-height:1.45`.
notes: Train 58, step 2: StatBlock gained an additive `size="tile"` variant (11px label / 16px Anton numeral / 11.5px note) for exactly this grid; AdminDashboard.tsx's 8 tiles (Workspaces/Sources/Ingest/Coverage/Research pipeline/Community pickups/Runtime/Emission factors) now use it with the artboard's wrapper geometry, a new `.cl-admin-stat-tile` class.

None of the 8 tiles in this grid carries a separate title line above the label/numeral row (unlike some other admin cards) — no SectionRule is mounted on these tiles, per the artboard's own markup, which shows no top rule inside any tile.

The artboard's 'Sources' tile example carries `border:1px solid #5A5552` with no box-shadow, read here as an active/selected-section illustration (Sources is the artboard's example active tab), not a base style; the product's `on` (aria-pressed) state overrides `borderColor` to `var(--brand)` for the active tile and is not asserted by this spec, which measures the base (inactive) tile only. `AdminDashboard`'s default `section` state is 'Workspaces' (tile 1), so this spec measures tile 2 ('Sources', inactive on mount) for base border/shadow/padding, confirmed by a direct debug read this session.

children.note: The note span is a direct sibling of the label/numeral row div, not nested inside it — the row div is the only other child, so `> span` (not `:nth-of-type(2)`, which counts among span siblings only and there is exactly one) reaches it. line-height 1.45 resolves to 16.675px at 11.5px font-size (getComputedStyle always reports a resolved px value, per this audit's own convention — see factcard.json/listrow.json).
